findings.change: None needed. If later work needs a clean shared store before a retry, add that inside the new-launch branch.
findings.claim: A unit read that is retried no longer has the first attempt's report cleared from the shared findings store when a later call resumes the round. The retry's preparation only covers its redirected output folder under the launch state. This leaves a stale file behind but harms nothing.
findings.evidence: read_sequence.go:99-105 sends a retry's outputs to <state>/declared/... and rewrites the brief to match (:127-138), and :124 now prepares only those paths. Collection and readFindingsMissing (:260-274) read the record's own declared outputs, which are the redirected ones, so nothing reads the stale file. A retry also starts from retryFailedStep inside waitStep, which comes after the old top-of-run preparation, so even the old code did not clear the store just before a retry within the same call.
